headline: Google shows you open until 6 PM, while your site says 8 to 5 and by appointment only.
summary: RV Revivals is Jamie and Lindsey's RV and van repair, renovation, and upgrade shop, run from a rural workshop near Alpine, with mobile service and remote troubleshooting too. The site is full of real work: services, prices, projects, vintage trailers, solar, and partner pages. Google Maps has a strong card for RV Revivals, category RV repair shop, at 6304 Japatul Highlands Rd with rvrevivals.com, (619) 808-6201, photos, a Book button, and an owner post from August. The leftover is about when people can come by: Google shows you Open until 6 PM, while your site says weekday hours of 8 to 5 and that visits are by appointment only.

signals.note: You show up on Google Maps as RV Revivals, RV repair shop, 6304 Japatul Highlands Rd, Alpine, with rvrevivals.com linked, (619) 808-6201, photos, customer reviews, a Book button, and a From the owner post dated Aug 24, 2026.
signals.next: Keep posting a project now and then. It shows people the shop is busy and current.

signals.note: Google, the People page, and the footer list (619) 808-6201. The Services page asks people to call or text (619)784-4631, three times. The Services page lists RVrevivals@gmail.com, and the Contact page lists service@rvrevivals.com.
signals.next: If both numbers reach you, add a line saying which is for what. If not, put one number everywhere. The same goes for the two inboxes.

signals.note: The Services FAQ says "M-F 8am-5pm, Saturday by appointment", and the Contact page says "We are by appointment only". Google showed Open, closes 6 PM, with 8 AM to 6 PM on the day we checked.
signals.next: Set Google to 8 to 5 and add a by-appointment note to the card, so nobody drives up the hill without a booking.

signals.note: Google has photos on your card, and the site has a Projects page plus pages for vintage trailers, upholstery, flooring, and food service vehicles.
signals.next: Add a before and after from the next build to Google.

signals.note: rvrevivals.com is full and current, with services, posted rates, an FAQ, projects, and partners. A few small typos: the Contact page says "You may loose cell service" and spells Descanco and Japtul in the directions, and the People page has equiped and deisel.
signals.next: A quick spelling pass on the Contact and People pages.

signals.note: Google links straight to rvrevivals.com, and the Contact page directions lead to Japatul Highlands Road, which matches the address on the card.
signals.next: Keep the name and address exactly like this on every listing.
